Clear the local cache

Source: R/pks_cache.R
pks_cache_clear.Rd

Deletes cached release files, for all data versions or only for the ones given. The files are downloaded again when they are next needed.

Usage

pks_cache_clear(version = NULL, ask = interactive())

Arguments

version

Character vector of data versions to remove, such as "2026.1", or NULL (default) for the whole cache.

ask

Ask for confirmation before deleting. Defaults to TRUE in interactive sessions.

Value

The removed files as a tibble like pks_cache_info(), invisibly.

Deutsch

Löscht Dateien aus dem Cache, für alle oder für die angegebenen Datenversionen. In interaktiven Sitzungen wird vorher nachgefragt.

See also

Other cache: pks_cache_info()

Examples

# \donttest{
pks_cache_clear(ask = FALSE)
#> Nothing to remove from the cache.
# }
